scenario: Retail bank treasury operations team reviews a batch of overnight deposit and withdrawal activity across customer accounts. The pipeline normalizes the overnight event ledger, computes per-account available balances and release scores, and produces a morning treasury memo listing which pending withdrawals to Approve or Hold before the business day opens.
info_flow: csv-pipeline normalizes the overnight account event file and computes per-account deposit and withdrawal totals → afrexai-hiring-scorecard evaluates each account's release eligibility using a weighted scorecard against available balance thresholds → reporting generates the morning treasury-operations release memo listing each pending withdrawal as Approve or Hold.
